_comment: Your client roster. Copy this file to clients.json and edit it.
The gate is keyed on the sender's EMAIL, not the name in the subject line —
clients misspell their own business name, but they can't misspell which
account they send from. The 'name' field is only used for display.
active  - process submissions, spend API credit
unpaid  - do NOT call the API; hold the submission and tell me
paused  - do NOT call the API; hold it quietly (client on a break)
Anyone NOT listed here is treated as unknown and never reaches the API.
Held emails are left unread, so flipping a status to 'active' makes the
next run pick them up automatically — nothing needs resending.
